minutes.headline: Board rescinded the old Blueberry Hill subdivision and declined to sponsor a neon open-sign exception
minutes.summary: The board took up an ANR lot swap on Reservoir Road, rescinded the 1989 Blueberry Hill subdivision after a neighbor raised a possible 50-foot buffer, and accepted a minor change to the Water District building plan. A business owner asked for a neon open-sign exception in the village district; the board would not sponsor it and pointed him to a citizen petition. Chair signing of decisions, a commercial sign bylaw, and warrant article packaging were discussed and left open.

public_comment.topic: Concern about surveyors tagging trees and a possible 50-foot no-build strip along the wall by the Blueberry Hill parcel.
A resident of the village district suggested consulting the architectural preservation district committee before changing sign rules.
A resident urged plain-English wording on warrant articles, such as saying a change is only renumbering.

what_happened.line: The board closed the public hearing and moved to rescind the 1989 Blueberry Hill definitive subdivision; the rescission motion's result was not audible.
The board would not sponsor a change to the sign bylaw for a neon open sign in the village district; the applicant will pursue a citizen petition.
A motion to accept minor changes to the Water District plan and a motion on the Reservoir Road lot swap were made, but the results were not audible.
Chair signing of decisions was tabled to the next agenda, when the full board is present.
Warrant article packaging was left open; the planner will email the board about separating the marijuana article.

why_it_matters: Rescinding an old subdivision approval changes what can be built on that parcel, and a neighbor raised a possible 50-foot no-build strip along the wall.
Sign rules in the village district will change only if voters take up a citizen petition at Town Meeting, and how warrant articles are packaged and worded decides what residents are asked to vote on.
watch_next: The next Planning Board agenda, where chair signing of decisions is due to return.
The planner's email to the board on separating the marijuana warrant article.
